content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: With Copy-on-Write, a derived Series or DataFrame behaves as an independent object from the user perspective. Update the object you intend to change directly (for example with `.loc[...] = ...`) rather than relying on chained assignment to mutate an original.

import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({"score": [10, 20, 30]})
subset = df["score"]
subset.iloc[0] = 99
print(df["score"].tolist())
